title: Refusing Committee
description: A heterogeneous committee of holographic membranes at different coarse-graining resolutions, each with a Youden-calibrated refusal gate; only confident members vote, and unanimous refusal is reported as its own outcome. A measured negative result: per-member refusal does not fix the plain committee's underperformance versus the best single member -- the gate filters low-confidence votes while the committee's errors are high-confidence, and miscalibrated gates collapse accuracy under distribution shift.
